description.value: Sweet Leaf Bakery & Cafe is a locally-owned bakery and espresso bar tucked inside Piccadilly Mall in the heart of Salmon Arm, serving creative seasonal desserts including cupcakes, macarons, and custom cakes alongside freshly roasted local coffee. The kitchen also turns out savoury light lunches — soups, focaccia, croissant sandwiches, and a variety of rolls — making it a solid mid-ride refuel stop. The cafe prides itself on sourcing as many locally made and harvested ingredients as possible.

address.value: 128 - 1151 10th Avenue South West, Salmon Arm, BC V1E 1T3
